# fitness — VitalOS Exercise Knowledge Base (KB)
# https://github.com/nimmsel23/fitness
# Data only (YAML). No app code. German coaching KB.

> Public repo. LLM web apps can read freely; connect GitHub to write/PRs. Start here, then read AGENTS.md and the paths below.

## Entry

- README: https://github.com/nimmsel23/fitness/blob/main/README.md
- Agent rules: https://github.com/nimmsel23/fitness/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- This index: https://github.com/nimmsel23/fitness/blob/main/llms.txt
- File manifest: https://github.com/nimmsel23/fitness/blob/main/MANIFEST.yml
- Inbox = PRs (target): https://github.com/nimmsel23/fitness/blob/main/INBOX.md

## Layout (repo root = former catalog/kb)

- `exercises/` — coach-approved expert exercises (`*.yml`; numeric ids preferred)
- `inbox/` — drafts awaiting coach approve (enrichment candidates)
- `muscles/` — muscle YAMLs + region buckets (ordered large → small)
- `muscle_index.yml` / `muscle_groups.json` — muscle indexes
- `anatomy_teaching/` — teaching layers per exercise
- `coaching_notes/` — short coaching drops
- `rules/` — catalog rules
- `registry/` — external id maps (wger / yuhonas), not training logic
- `vendor/free-exercise-db/` — pinned upstream submodule (yuhonas); SHA in `yuhonas.ref`
- `vendor/free-exercise-db/dist/exercises.json` — yuhonas live bulk (submodule)
- `vendor/fma/` — pinned FMA 5.1.0 (uw-sig/FMA); SHA in `fma.ref` — OWL via Git LFS
- `registry/fma_kb_map.yml` — catalog muscle id ↔ FMA IRI
- `exercises/unreviewed_wger.yml` — wger bulk source (API snapshot; no git submodule)
- `activities.yml`, `config.yml`, `wger_mapping.yml`, `external_db_mapping.yml`

## How to use

1. List or search YAML under `exercises/` and `inbox/` via GitHub file API / connector.
2. Read one file fully before editing; preserve `exercise_id`, external ids, and existing structure.
3. New or incomplete exercises belong in `inbox/`, not silently into `exercises/`.
4. Approved expert truth is only `exercises/` after coach gate.
5. Do not invent a second KB copy; this repo is the data SOT. Catalog Python lives in coach-dev.

## Cloud enrichment fallback

- Manual / LLM prompt: `.github/prompts/enrich-inbox.md`
- CI: Actions workflow `Enrich Inbox` (`workflow_dispatch` or `repository_dispatch` `enrich-inbox`)
- Script: `scripts/enrich_inbox.py` (Gemini → PR on `inbox/` only)

## Consumers

- coach-dev submodule path: `fitness/catalog/kb`
- Local checkout: `~/dev/fitness`
